fnol_text: My name is Dana Herrera and I live at 946 Sycamore Court, Dover, DE 19914. You can reach me on (555) 979-9647 or dana.herrera@example.com. On 1 November 2023 another car pulled out of a side road and hit my front passenger side. The other driver, Fatima Santos, admitted they didn't see me. Policy MT-2023-00123. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mr Herrera on (555) 979-9647 to acknowledge the claim. Dana confirmed the loss date as 1 November 2023.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Hannah Wojcik gave a statement by phone.
Third-party driver Fatima Santos reports bruised ribs and attended Riverside Medical Center. Dana reports a sprained wrist.
